treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Kingdom of Norway and Australia for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2006)
eif_quote: Avtalens undertegningsdato 08-08-2006 ... Avtalens ikrafttredelsesdato 12-09-2007 | Art. 29(2): Overenskomsten trer i kraft på datoen for den siste av disse bekjentgjørelser ... a. i Australia: i. med hensyn til skatter tilbakeholdt ved kilden ... for inntekt opptjent på eller etter 1. januar i det påfølgende kalenderåret etter det året overenskomsten trer i kraft; ... b. i Norge, med hensyn til skatter av inntekt som vedkommer det kalenderår ... som følger etter det år overenskomsten trer i kraft
source_title: Lovdata traktat 2006-08-08-13: Overenskomst mellom Norge og Australia (Norwegian text; Norwegian and English equally authentic) + MLI positions of Norway and Australia

rates.article: Article 10(2)(a) as modified by MLI art. 8(1)
rates.quote: a. 5 prosent av dividendenes bruttobeløp hvis dividendenes virkelige rettighetshaver er et selskap (annet enn et interessentskap) som direkte innehar minst 10 prosent av de stemmeberettigede aksjene i det selskap som utdeler dividendene; og [MLI art. 8(1): 365-day holding period, both Norway and Australia notified Art. 10(2)(a)]
b. 15 prosent av dividendenes bruttobeløp i alle andre tilfeller.

2. Slike renter kan imidlertid også skattlegges i den stat hvor rentene skriver seg fra, i samsvar med lovgivningen i denne stat, men den skatt som ilegges, skal ikke overstige 10 prosent av rentenes bruttobeløp.

2. Slik royalty kan imidlertid også skattlegges i den stat hvor den skriver seg fra, i samsvar med lovgivningen i denne stat, men den skatt som ilegges, skal ikke overstige 5 prosent av royaltyens bruttobeløp.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of [the Convention], a benefit under [the Convention] shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of [the Convention]. [Norway's MLI notification: replaces existing Articles 10(7), 11(9) and 12(7) of the Australia convention]

notes: Dividends: Art. 10(2)(a) 5% tier (>=10% of voting shares, direct) applied from 2008-01-01 without holding period; MLI art. 8(1) 365-day holding period added from 2020-01-01 (Norway notified 10(2)(a) under art. 8(4) and reserved only for 10(3); Australia notified 'Norway Article 10(2)(a) and 10(3)'). Art. 10(3): 0% where beneficial owner company held >=80% of voting shares for 12 months ending on the date the dividend is declared AND is listed/owned by listed companies on a recognised stock exchange or obtains competent-authority determination - not modelled as a plain tier (listing condition). Interest Art. 11(3): exemption for interest derived by governments/central banks/government financial institutions and by unrelated financial institutions (except back-to-back loans, 10%) - not modelled. Australia: WHT effective for income derived on/after 2008-01-01; Norway: calendar year 2008. Replaced the 1982 convention. MLI WHT effect 2020-01-01 per map.json.
unverified: MLI art. 8 holding period applied to 10(2)(a) based on matching notifications in both MLI positions; no synthesised text consulted
